description.en: Channels, auditors and flows are configured on the Prompt Moderation page; a flow bound to a group (or the default group 0) decides what is moderated.
description.zh: 渠道、审核器和流程在“提示词审核”页面配置；绑定到分组（或默认分组 0）的流程决定审核哪些请求。

ui:help.en: Observe: requests pass at once and are moderated in the background; users on the watch list at the enforce level are moderated first. Enforce: every request waits for the flow.
ui:help.zh: 观察：请求直接放行、后台审核；观察名单中“拦截级”的用户先审后发。拦截：所有请求都等审核结果。

ui:details.en: A hit refuses the request only when it was moderated before the upstream call. Moderation errors always let the request pass.
ui:details.zh: 只有先审后发的请求命中时才会被拒绝。审核出错一律放行。

ui:help.en: Requests of these users are never moderated. Add the administrators here: the plugin cannot tell them apart yet.
ui:help.zh: 这些用户的请求不审核。请把管理员加进来：插件目前识别不了管理员。

ui:help.en: 403 by default; 400 or 451 are common alternatives.
Returned to the client when a request is refused (code moderation_blocked).
ui:help.zh: 请求被拒绝时返回给客户端的错误信息（错误码 moderation_blocked）。

ui:help.en: The first suspicious record adds the user at the observe level.
ui:help.zh: 首次出现可疑记录时，以观察级加入名单。

ui:help.en: Each new violation at the observe level extends it.
ui:help.zh: 观察级每次违规都会顺延。

ui:title.zh: 每多少次违规做一次 AI 分析

ui:help.en: Counted now; the analysis itself comes in a later version. 0 = never.
ui:help.zh: 目前只计数，AI 分析在后续版本提供。0 表示从不。

ui:help.en: Suspicious requests within the window that ban a user (false positives excluded). 0 disables automatic bans.
ui:help.zh: 窗口内达到该次数的可疑请求即自动封禁用户（不含误报）。0 表示不自动封禁。

ui:help.en: 0 bans until an administrator unblocks the user.
ui:help.zh: 0 表示直到管理员手动解封。

ui:help.en: Hits are always recorded.
ui:help.zh: 命中始终记录。

ui:help.en: Keep the moderated text, and the raw user messages of first-stage hits. They may contain user data.
ui:help.zh: 保存被审核的文本，以及第一级命中时用户原样发来的消息，可能包含用户数据。

ui:help.en: Concurrent auditor calls on each node; also the number of background workers.
ui:help.zh: 每个节点同时进行的审核调用数，也是后台审核的工作协程数。

ui:help.en: Requests waiting for background moderation on each node.
ui:help.zh: 每个节点等待后台审核的请求数上限。

ui:details.en: When the queue is full, new requests are not moderated and are counted as dropped.
ui:details.zh: 队列满了之后新请求不再审核，并计入丢弃数。

ui:help.en: A clean pass of the same input under the same flow version is reused this long. 0 disables the cache.
ui:help.zh: 同一流程版本下相同输入的干净通过结论复用多久。0 表示不缓存。

ui:details.en: Hits, errors, skipped auditors and URL images are never cached.
ui:details.zh: 命中、出错、有审核器被跳过、带 URL 图片的输入都不缓存。

ui:help.en: Whitespace is collapsed, then the text is cut to this length.
ui:help.zh: 压缩空白后截到这个长度。

ui:help.en: Text shorter than this (ignoring whitespace) and without images is not moderated.
ui:help.zh: 去掉空白后短于该字数且没有图片的输入不审核。

ui:help.en: Used by Jev auditors without their own table. Empty = the built-in Chinese set.
ui:help.zh: 没有自己题集的 Jev 审核器使用它。留空使用内置中文题集。

ui:help.en: OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
ui:help.zh: OpenAI 兼容接口地址。

ui:details.zh: 以 /v1 结尾时拼接 /chat/completions，否则拼接 /v1/chat/completions。

description.en: Read only. On the first start of 0.2 they were turned into a channel, an LLM auditor and a flow.
description.zh: 只读。0.2 首次启动时已转换成渠道、LLM 审核器和流程。

ui:help.en: Sent as Authorization: Bearer. Leave empty to keep the stored key.
ui:help.zh: 以 Authorization: Bearer 方式发送。留空时保留已存储的密钥。

ui:help.en: Must support tool calling (function calling).
ui:help.zh: 需要支持工具调用（function calling）。

ui:help.en: Leave empty to use the built-in prompt.
ui:help.zh: 留空使用内置提示词。

ui:details.en: {{categories}} in the prompt is replaced by the category list, one "- id: description" per line.
ui:details.zh: 提示词中的 {{categories}} 会替换为分类列表（每行一个“- id：说明”）。

ui:help.en: Leave empty to use the 12 built-in categories. The model can only choose from these ids.
ui:help.zh: 留空使用内置的 12 个分类。模型只能从这些分类 id 中选择。

ui:help.en: Lowercase letters, digits and _ (at most 32).
ui:help.zh: 小写字母、数字和下划线，最多 32 个字符。

ui:placeholder.zh: 违法犯罪：毒品、武器、诈骗等

ui:help.en: No longer used: moderation errors always let the request pass.
ui:help.zh: 已不再生效：审核出错一律放行。

ui:help.en: Share of requests moderated, chosen deterministically by text.
ui:help.zh: 按文本确定性抽样的审核比例。

ui:help.en: Only moderate requests of these groups; empty means all groups.
ui:help.zh: 只审核这些分组的请求，留空表示全部分组。

ui:help.en: Only moderate requests for matching client models (* and ? wildcards); empty means all.
ui:help.zh: 只审核匹配的客户端模型（支持 * 和 ? 通配），留空表示全部。
